page_title: MiaoYan, Markdown notes for Mac, iPhone and iPad

sources.entry: MiaoYan - Lightweight Markdown app to help you write great sentences.

summary.name: MiaoYan
summary.one_liner: MiaoYan is a native Markdown note app for Mac, iPhone and iPad that stores notes as plain .md files in a folder you choose.
use_cases: writing and organizing Markdown notes on a Mac
syncing notes across Mac, iPhone and iPad via iCloud Drive
turning a note into a slide presentation
comparing source and typeset preview while writing
keeping notes as portable local files
summary.what_it_does: MiaoYan is a Markdown note app built natively with Swift 6 rather than Electron. Notes are plain .md files in a user-chosen folder, and iCloud Drive or Nutstore can handle sync between devices. It offers a three-column layout of folders, notes and writing, plus a split mode with real-time preview and bidirectional scroll sync. Supported features include GitHub Flavored Markdown, LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, Markmap, wikilinks with backlinks, version history, auto-formatting, a CLI, and slides split with ---. The page says it does not collect note data.
notable: Native Swift 6 app, not Electron, with 60fps bidirectional scroll sync in split mode
Mac version is free and open source (Homebrew or GitHub Releases); iPhone and iPad versions are App Store only
Notes are plain .md files in a user-chosen folder, synced via iCloud Drive or Nutstore
Supports wikilinks and backlinks, LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, Markmap and Markdown slides
caveats: iPhone and iPad versions are paid one-time App Store purchases and are not open source
Requires macOS 12 or later, and iOS 18 or iPadOS 18 or later for iPhone and iPad
Cross-device sync depends on iCloud Drive or another file-sync client; no built-in sync is described
